outcome: Perceived level of respectful maternity care
cohort: The study participants were women aged 18 years and above, who had given birth to a healthy newborn within the previous 42 days, resided in urban areas of Bhopal, India, understood Hindi or English, and had no cognitive impairments.
finding: Although most women (82.6%) reported experiencing respectful maternity care, notable gaps remained in timely and equitable care, with socioeconomic status, education, and obstetric factors influencing perceptions.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery showed domain-specific associations with the level of perceived respectful maternity care (p = 0.031).
